sources.why: Fields of a Daily Log record, including the narrative fields a draft would target.
Business statuses of a Daily Log, to keep an assistance acceptance separate from them.
Hours already flow into the Daily Log from time cards, so a draft must not restate or invent them.
Structured items already attach to a Daily Log, outside the scope of a narrative draft.
Incidents are their own record type linked to the log, not free text to be summarized.
Documented range of log types, useful to bound what a narrative draft covers.
Per module role permissions, including read only and own records only.
How roles are defined, the mechanism an assisted operation would have to inherit from.
What a change order commits to, the reason this workflow is deferred.
An approval path already exists for change orders, outside any assistance.
An RFI exists to remove ambiguity, which is why drafting answers is deferred.
How an RFI is created and routed, for the deferred line.
How the account key for the integration is described in the vendor documentation.
Lead routing is already covered by an existing mechanism, a line where nothing should be added.
Published triggers and write actions of the integration, read once and dated.
